🔥 MINOKAWA — Hearts Out, Strategy In | ROLG Major 2025 Pre-Match Interview!

"Just like other guilds, we wanna WIN. And for us, winning could mean a lot of things."

💛 Minokawa enters the battlefield with fire, family, and full hearts. Representing the Philippines, this rising guild is ready to make their mark in Ragnarok Landverse: Genesis — ROLG Major 2025.

We sat down with Violette, and here’s what she had to say:
🎤 Q: How has your guild been preparing for the ROLG Major 2025?
 🗣️ Violette:
 Minokawa has been working so hard from the beginning — from CBT to OBT and now the Major.
 Even with time constraints, we’ve chosen players who best represent our team.
 Our 10 + 1 players have been practicing late nights, developing strategies for every possible situation.

🎤 Q: What’s your main goal for this tournament?
 🗣️ Violette:
 Just like other guilds, we wanna WIN. But for us, winning isn’t just about results.
 It’s about giving 100% of our heart and soul into the game.
 As a PH representative, qualifying this far is already a huge win.
 We want to win the hearts of our supporters — those who believed in our 10+1 players.
 From being a new guild to making it here… it’s a dream come true.

🎤 Q: Which guild do you see as your biggest rival and why?
 🗣️ Violette:
 All six guilds are strong — they wouldn’t be here if they weren’t.
 But from our journey so far, the biggest rival of Minokawa is FiGuild.
 We’ve seen them dominate the 36v36.
 Defending against them is tough. Defeating them? Even tougher.
 Whoever wins on the Day of Domination will have truly earned it.

🎤 Q: How do you keep morale high during tough matches?
 🗣️ Violette:
 We always remind our players to do their best and play with heart.
 No matter the result, the Minokawa family — and our sister guilds — will be proud.
 Our goal is to have fun, and that’s exactly what we’re going to do.
🎤 Q: What message do you have for your fans before the tournament starts?

 🗣️ Violette:
 The final leg is here — and we’re ready to give it everything.
 Your support means the world to us.
 From practicing with us, to giving feedback, to cheering us on —
 You’ve pushed us to be better.
 On the Day of Domination, we won’t just be 10+1 players —
 We’ll be fighting for all of Minokawa and our sister guilds.
 Let’s make this tournament one for the books. ✨

🎤 Q: One emoji to describe your strategy?
 🗣️ Violette: 🙀 (surprise!)
Minokawa may be a new name to some, but they’re here with purpose, passion, and pride.

 Watch out — you won’t see them coming.

DPWH COMPOUND FIRE AFTERMATH

IN PHOTOS: Aftermath of the fire that broke out at the DPWH–Bureau of Research and Standards building in Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City, past noon on Wednesday, October 22.

The fire was declared out at 1:49 p.m., after the third alarm was raised at 12:56 p.m., according to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla has also asked the NBI and the BFP to investigate the incident, which occurred amid ongoing probes into infrastructure projects.

📷 BFP NCR via Facebook
